[Andrej Karpathy](https://karpathy.ai/) [joined Anthropic](https://www.forbes.com/sites/aliciapark/2026/05/19/openai-cofounder-and-former-tesla-ai-leader-andrej-karpathy-joins-anthropic/) on May 19, 2026, seven months after his October interview with [Dwarkesh Patel](https://www.dwarkesh.com/). He'll be working on pre-training under team lead [Nick Joseph](https://x.com/nickevanjoseph) and helping launch a new team focused on using Claude to develop Anthropic's models. On X, he wrote that "the next few years at the frontier of LLMs will be especially formative."

That news is the reason for this revisit. [Karpathy: AGI Is Still a Decade Away](/posts/20251018-karpathy-agi-decade-away/) — the original takeaways post on the Dwarkesh interview — now carries:

- A top-of-page **callout** about the Anthropic move, with a pointer to the *Future of education* chapter where Karpathy describes [Eureka](https://eurekalabs.ai/) as the place he can "a lot more uniquely add value than an incremental improvement in the frontier lab." Read alongside the news, the framing in that chapter shifts.
- A full **enriched transcript** at the bottom — chapter outline with anchor IDs, first-mention hyperlinks, bracketed expansions, editor's-note callouts on factually questionable claims, and a numbered References block.
